campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered updates to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work (not to exceed $335,000), and the annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27. The Council also considered a budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment, though details on that item were limited.
keyTopics: Proposed modifications to Council Policy Section 14 (Theater Use Policy), effective September 16
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, not to exceed $335,000
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business including meeting minutes, vendor payments, and a conflict-of-interest code update, along with final map approvals for two residential lot splits. The Council also held public hearings on two appeals of Planning Commission decisions involving properties on 6th Street and Oak Place, and discussed law enforcement service options ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of Planning Commission approval for a single-family residence and ADU design review/setback variance at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a three-lot subdivision (Tentative Map and Design Review) at 14486 Oak Place
Law enforcement service options for Saratoga, ahead of public town halls on September 19 and 30
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council took up a routine wastewater treatment plant agreement, a councilmember's continued service on the regional transit board, and a temporary moratorium on new detention or custodial facility applications in the city. The Council also considered appointments to several city commissions and an updated legal services contract with its outside law firm.
keyTopics: Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Councilmember Jonathan Weinberg's reappointment to the Valley Transportation Authority (VTA) Board
Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on detention or custodial facility applications
Appointments to the Complete Streets, Environmental, and Planning Commissions
Amendment to the city's legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating retainer and hourly rates

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine business, including approval of minutes from prior meetings and a monthly financial report for July 2026. The Council also considered several contract-related items, including amendments to existing agreements and new professional services agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Town Council and Closed Session meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026
A second amendment to an existing agreement (Town Manager authorization)
A first amendment to a Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning-related agreement
New professional services agreements for Town Manager execution

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 23, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole reviewed the upcoming City Council agendas for September 29 and October 6, 2026, including whether any items needed new additions or a scheduled speaking time. The committee also looked at the public record for a recent one-week period, reviewed mayoral travel requests, and considered approving District 1 San Jose Sharks Community Funds for the California Association of Local Agency Formation Commissions.
keyTopics: Review and finalization of the September 29, 2026 Council agenda
Review of the October 6, 2026 draft Council agenda
Public record review for September 10-17, 2026
Mayor's requests to travel
District 1 Sharks Community Funds approval for the California Association of Local Agency Formation Commissions

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — September 22, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met in closed session to discuss potential litigation involving several fire truck manufacturers and to consider the appointment of a City Attorney, then held a regular session covering topics including field renovations at Shoreline, a solar and battery storage energy project, historic preservation zoning updates, an active transportation plan, and pay raises for the City Clerk and City Manager. Two proclamations were also on the agenda recognizing National Arts and Humanities Month and Childhood Cancer Awareness Month.
keyTopics: Closed-session discussion of potential litigation involving fire apparatus manufacturers (Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer, FAMA)
Public employee appointment discussion for the City Attorney position
Professional services agreement for renovating Shoreline athletic fields
Energy services contract for a solar photovoltaic and battery storage project
Historic Preservation Ordinance and zoning map update, plus Active Transportation Plan adoption and salary increases for the City Clerk and City Manager

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 19, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: This was a brief special morning session of the Sunnyvale City Council held for the annual State of the City event. The agenda mainly covered logistics such as the event schedule and standard procedures for public comment and participation before the meeting adjourned.
keyTopics: State of the City special session and event schedule
Procedures for in-person, online, and written public comment

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 15, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met to discuss a real estate negotiation involving city-owned property at 10480 Finch Avenue with the Cupertino Union School District, along with a closed-session item on potential litigation. The public portion covered routine business including approval of past meeting minutes, accounts payable, an audit committee ordinance update, a new AI policy for the Council, and the city's response to a county Civil Grand Jury report on pothole damage claims.
keyTopics: Closed-session discussion of property price and terms for 10480 Finch Avenue involving the Cupertino Union School District
Closed-session consideration of a potential lawsuit the city might initiate
Postponement of an ordinance updating building code definitions for attics, garages, and square footage to October 6
Adoption of a new Artificial Intelligence policy for City Council use
Approval of the city's response to the county Civil Grand Jury report on pothole damage claims processes
Appointment of a Council subcommittee to evaluate proposals for the city's 2027-2028 lobbyist

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council held a joint meeting with the Stadium Authority Board that began with a closed session covering ongoing legal disputes and property damage claims, followed by several proclamations recognizing community observances. The Council also considered agreements for building systems maintenance and office furniture procurement for City facilities, and deferred action on a proposed zoning ordinance related to replacement housing units.
keyTopics: Closed session on litigation with the California Department of Water Resources involving Silicon Valley Power and the Northern California Power Agency
Closed session on a property damage claim filed by Travelers Insurance as Subrogee for Moriel Real Estate, LLC
Deferral of an ordinance to establish new zoning rules (Chapter 18.68) for replacement housing units required under state law
Proclamations for Hispanic Heritage Month, Childhood Cancer Awareness Month, and Public Power Week
Agreements for HVAC control systems maintenance (Syserco, Inc.) and increased office furniture purchase order (D & D Learning Spaces)

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council reviewed a draft plan for federal Community Development Block Grant funding, received updates on the city's red light camera traffic safety program, and looked at the physical condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The Council also considered several financial actions related to winding down the former Redevelopment Agency, including the sale of refunding bonds.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program presentation
Condition assessment of the Milpitas Community Center
Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency resolutions, including sale and issuance of refunding bonds
City Council calendar of upcoming meetings

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Architectural Review Board — September 17, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Architectural Review Board considered a proposed sign program for the office property at 950 Page Mill Road, which would add a monument sign displaying the property's own 'Page Mill Labs' branding along with identification panels for four tenants. The board's role was to make a recommendation on whether the sign design fits architectural review standards.
keyTopics: Proposed multi-tenant monument sign at 950 Page Mill Road
Inclusion of non-tenant property branding ('Page Mill Labs') alongside tenant panels
Design of four individual tenant identification panels
Project found exempt from CEQA review as an accessory structure
